title: Jungle Baby Shower
description: Sage, olive, and gold garland framing a jungle backdrop, with lettered baby blocks, plush safari animals, and a long banquet table run with a monstera-leaf runner and dark green chargers. A greenery banner marks the welcome wall, cupcakes sit out on monstera leaves along the dessert run, and the favour table is finished with olive and white balloons over printed keepsake cards.
